revision_note: clarified during synthetic software checks that lookbacks count observed completed hourly bars and reset at every mapping transition, including when a contract returns. no bars are filled. no empirical strategy P&L has run; the roll gate remains unresolved. the grid, splits, selection metric, costs and delays are unchanged. version 1 and its lock are archived in research/.
question: how much of a futures signal survives later periods, other markets, costs and slower orders?
signal_timeframe: 1h UTC, start-stamped; signal known at scheduled hour end

momentum.rule: long when completed close is above the close lookback_hours observed completed hourly bars earlier within the current uninterrupted contract segment; otherwise flat

mean_reversion.rule: long when completed close is at least entry_z standard deviations below the mean of the prior lookback_hours observed completed hourly bars; exit when close reaches or exceeds that prior mean; reset at every contract transition

selection.metric: net Sharpe on daily account-capital returns in the base scenario
selection.tie_break: lower fill count, then configuration id
selection.validation_and_final_usage: report the locked development winner and rank changes; never tune on final results

execution.fill: first observed 1-minute open at or after completed signal bar end plus delay
execution.roll: exit at open of final old-contract minute; re-enter at open of first new-contract minute

baselines: always long with the same scheduled roll policy and costs

statistics.daily_return: daily net P&L divided by stated starting capital; no futures price percentage return
statistics.annualization: 252 trading days; sample standard deviation; zero volatility Sharpe is undefined
statistics.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap of five consecutive trading days, 2000 replicates, seed 1729
statistics.walk_forward: secondary diagnostic: three calendar years of selection, then the next calendar year of evaluation

prior_exposure: the local nq-powell project already reports NQ and cross-market results by year through 2026. no 2024-2026 period can honestly be called untouched; historical_final is a historical evaluation. version 1 was frozen before this project's grid ran. synthetic software results were inspected before version 2; no empirical results from the new nine-configuration grid have been viewed.
roll_gate: empirical futures P&L is blocked until all five minute exports have verified date-to-contract schedules and a documented roll policy
data_change_rule: a coverage correction can revise the plan only with a written reason and a new lock before viewing strategy performance
